up_p1: The Popular Unity (UP) was a Chilean political coalition of left-wing, center-left, and Christian left parties that led Salvador Allende to the presidency in 1970.
up_p2: In the presidential election of September 4, 1970, Salvador Allende obtained the first relative majority. Valparaíso, as the main port, was a key setting for labor mobilization and support for the coalition.
up_note: Note: Valparaíso was named "Seat of the Ministry of the Navy" during this period, seeking to decentralize the country and strengthen the city's historical bond with the ocean.
admin_p1: The Valparaíso Region is one of the sixteen regions into which Chile is divided. It is the second most populated region in the country and is administratively divided into provinces and communes.
admin_p2: The region has 8 provinces, including the island territories of Easter Island and the Juan Fernández Archipelago. The Valparaíso Province is the main administrative hub.
catering_tagline: The port's tourist and culinary engine
catering_p1: Valparaíso is famous for its gastronomic offer, which mixes fresh seafood with a bohemian tradition. The catering and restaurant sector represents a fundamental pillar of the local economy.
catering_p2: The "Chorrillana" is the flagship dish of the port, originating in the Casino Social J. Cruz. Along with fish and seafood, they define the identity of the hills and the flatlands.
mining_tagline: The "White Gold" and the awakening of the labor movement
mining_p1: During the late 19th century, Chile dominated the global saltpeter market. The "Oficinas Salitreras" were industrial settlements in the middle of the desert functioning as autonomous cities, where workers lived and bought goods in "pulperías" using tokens instead of national currency.
mining_h2_2: Santa María School Massacre in Iquique
mining_p2: Precarious living conditions led to massive strikes. In 1907, thousands of saltpeter miners marched to Iquique. On December 21, the army opened fire on strikers sheltering in the Santa María School, marking one of the most tragic and significant episodes in Chilean social history.
mining_note: Historical Milestone: This event was fundamental to the emergence of modern trade union movements in Chile.
